glyphEdges.region: The reference's visible text boxes, widened by one pixel
glyphEdges.reason: Chromium places glyphs on whole pixels and GPUI at sub-pixel phases, so the anti-aliased edges of the same text differ; moved, missing or recoloured glyphs still count
